sloka: श्रुत्वा तु भाषितं वाक्यं मम राम शुभाक्षरम् ।प्राञ्जलिः प्रत्युवाचेदं स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन ।। ७.७८.१ ॥
transliteration: śrutvā tu bhāṣitaṁ vākyaṁ mama rāma śubhākṣaram ।prāñjaliḥ pratyuvācedaṁ sa svargī raghunandana ।। 7.78.1 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, O delight of the Raghus, having heard my auspicious words, that celestial being replied with folded hands.
